## Change and contract

Describe the concrete problem, resulting behavior and affected contract or adapter.
For semantic changes, identify the declared profile and the compatibility impact.

## Validation

List the commands and actual results, including relevant healthy/fault controls.
Keep local tests, native integration, performance measurements and CI results
distinct. Record failures, skipped checks and unsupported configurations.

## Public-data review

Confirm that examples, fixtures and diagnostics are safe to publish. Use synthetic
inputs and remove credentials, prompts, model artifacts and identifying paths.
